name: Anime Los Angeles
blurb: Long-running January anime convention at the Long Beach Convention Center, with a cosplay masquerade, concerts, an idol showcase and artist alley.

editions.evidence: Homepage and guests-page text: 'Animé Los Angeles 22 🕒 January 7-10, 2027 Long Beach Convention Center'; guests page: 'STAY TUNED FOR ALA 22 GUEST ANNOUNCEM[ENTS]'.

notes: The batch seed's venue/city (Ontario, CA) is stale: the live site shows ALA has moved to the Long Beach Convention Center ('Animal Los Angeles 22 ... January 7-10, 2027 Long Beach Convention Center'), confirmed on both the homepage and the guests page; using Long Beach, not Ontario. The guests page shows zero guest photo candidates and says 'STAY TUNED FOR ALA 22 GUEST ANNOUNCEMENTS', so guests is 'none-yet'. Organizer confirmed from the site's own policies blurb: 'Animé Los Angeles is sponsored by the California Anime Foundation, a registered 501(c)3 Non-profit corporation'. Cover falls back to the current wide color logo (uploaded 2025-05) rather than the og:image, which is dated artwork for 'ALA-20' (two editions stale) or the generic crowd/venue photos among the hero images.
